questions.question: OP-01/O57 (summaries, pointer): O4, O7 and O9 still summarise decisions the reopens changed (O8 and O12 were already amended by D81 and D82), and O5 points to "D18's last column", which D50's added column makes ambiguous. Amend them as D74 did O11? Source: O57, D74's reason (the summary is what the landing flow reads first).

options.label: Amend O4, O7, O9, O5 (Recommended)
options.description: One amendment states the new summaries and O5's pointer; each item gains 'Amended by'. Landing flows read a current summary.
options.preview:
O4: OP-01/D12 to D14, D57, D58, D97: T_connect bounds each
  connect after name resolution, T_idle each wait for the next
  byte, defaults 20 s and 60 s; no whole-call deadline, a
  caller's own deadline is a cancellation (D58); no figure
  bounds a call's total waiting; declared deviations: Local and
  SFTP's server-side disk (D14), name resolution (D57).

O7: OP-01/D23, D63, D64, D82, D83, D87: real-time
  read-after-write order after a completed API mutation or a
  completed O3 change of E3, E5 or E19; strong as the normal
  value, eventual as a declared deviation, conditioned for
  Local and SFTP on a network file system shared across hosts.

O9: OP-01/D27 to D34 give its principle and first categories,
  as D48, D53 to D56, D61, D62, D84 to D86, D88 and D99 amend
  them. (Derivation: every AX-10 decision and every decision
  whose Amends names D27 to D34.)

O5: points to D18's column "handle's lifetime ends".

options.label: Summaries only
options.description: O4, O7, O9 amended; O5's pointer left, its column found by name from D18's table.

options.label: As is
options.description: Landing flows follow the Amended-by links from each decision; summaries stay stale, as O11's was before D74.

questions.question: OP-01/O61 (D68's list): D68 names KEY-001, KEY-013, TREE-001, TREE-002 as cited and model-tagged; the record's decisions (D4, D8, D9, D19, D34, D38, D53, D66, D67, D90) also cite KEY-002, KEY-004, KEY-005 and KEY-008, all tagged @spec in KeyModel.lean (Grep this session). The reopens compared only TREE-001 and KEY-013. Complete it how?

options.label: Complete list, no new read (Recommended)
options.description: D68 lists all eight clauses, the citing decisions and the tags, and says only TREE-001 and KEY-013 were compared. Spec 052 'Tested against': KeyModel.lean restates and informs review, no bridge makes it govern, so a comparison changes no decision.

D9, D19, D34, D38, D53, D66, D67 and D90 cite KEY-001,
KEY-002, KEY-004, KEY-005, KEY-008, KEY-013, TREE-001 and
TREE-002, each tagged @spec in KeyModel.lean (KEY-*) or in

them restated; the others were not compared.

options.description: Same list, and this session reads the KEY-002/004/005/008 clauses in KeyModel.lean and compares them with spec 052 before writing; more reading, a stronger line.

questions.question: OP-01/O62 (log fidelity): beyond D75's two, the review found D41's dialog option ending "a test that asserts one is a defect" and D43's reading "(S3-compatible endpoints)" and "an unnamed non-AWS endpoint gets the deviations (eventual, no pinned resume)", both dropped from the record. Restore, and run a word-by-word sweep?

options.label: Restore both, no sweep (Recommended)
options.description: Both texts restored as D75 did. No sweep: the committed decision log keeps each dialog's options (O40 and O62 quote from it), and specs are written from Decisions, which two claim-by-claim reviews checked.

options.label: Restore + sweep note
options.description: Restore both and leave a note for the next /observe-review to sweep every decision word by word against the log (this session cannot: the log is outside the ground).

options.label: As is
options.description: Neither restored; the record keeps two more option texts that differ from what the dialogs offered.
